name: Tag Team (Combat, Teamwork)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Improved Grapple

Benefit(s): If an ally with this feat fails a grapple check to maintain a grapple, you gain a +2 check to your own grapple checks against the same opponent until the end of your next turn.
